summary: @onereach/si-switch preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package is advertised as a Vue.js switch input component but its package.json declares a `preinstall` script running `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs uses obfuscator-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d`,...) to hide arch/platform detection, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/`, and then calls `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])` against a sibling file. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727KB bundle with a shuffled string-array decoder (`function WV8StW(MmgoCP,etDiOOB,JqTtnbZ){...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())...}`) and a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header — an opaque compiled payload not inspectable as source. Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute a bundled opaque payload at `npm install` time bypasses Node-focused install scanners and provides arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine, with no relationship to the package's stated UI-component purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
